capabilities: Show immediate subfolders and direct notes in two panes
Create, rename, move, reorder and trash real files
Focus a folder or expand a full folder tree
disambiguation: Not a OneNote importer or sync tool; it browses the vault's own folders in a OneNote-style layout.
extras: Interface is Simplified Chinese only; no network requests, accounts or payments; mobile/touch behavior untested on physical devices; no OneNote import or conversion.
problem: The file explorer shows the whole vault tree at once, so switching between notebooks and browsing one folder level at a time is cumbersome.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin for OneNote-style navigation through your existing folders and notes.
Dual-pane browsing with folders, tags, properties, previews, keyboard navigation, and manual ordering.
Notebook/section/page navigation in a popup or sidebar; configurable root folder, folder-note subpages, and drag reordering/moves.

summary: Sidebar navigator that treats top-level folders as notebooks and shows subfolders and direct notes in two panes, with direct file management.
